name: block-3-apps-runner
description: Runner scripts for the Block 3 applications

scripts.dev: node ../node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n WEB,ORDER,INVENTORY -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix order-api" "npm run dev --prefix inventory-service"
scripts.seed: npm run seed --prefix inventory-service && npm run seed --prefix order-api
